'''Budboo''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Snapshade]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies.

==Overview==
Current Description: "A mysterious little sprout that prefers to stay hidden in dark, secluded corners. Doesn't know how to say no and often gets dragged out by [[Buddi]] for a sunbath."

Budboo is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A sprouting seed with a small, round creature inside. The creature is black with green eyes and has two tiny leaves over its head. It hides behind the seed coat, which is red and orange in color.

Budboo's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red and orange with purple and blue.

== Evolution Trial ==
Budboo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Snapshade]] you need to complete the following task:

* Purchase any 10 [[Decorations|buildings]].

== Trivia ==
* Budboo and its evolutions were added to the game on 7/29/2026 alongside [[Kaiseroo]] and [[Saberheart]].
